question: The International Cricket Council (ICC) Women's Cricket World Cup 2022 was hosted by _______ in March and April 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __New Zealand____.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ICC Women’s World Cup 2022 began on 4 March 2022 in New Zealand.
 
• It was played in a round-robin format
 
• The 8 teams who are part of it are India, Pakistan, Australia, Bangladesh, New Zealand, South Africa, England, and West Indies.
 
• The ICC Women’s World Cup 2022 final was played on 3rd April at Hagley Oval in Christchurch.
 
• The event was earlier supposed to be held in 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The ICC Women’s T20 World Cup 2023 will be held from 10 to 26 February 2023 in South Africa.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Australia was crowned the winner of the 2022 ICC Women's Cricket World Cup, on 3 April 2022.
 
• This was their seventh title.
 
• Australia defeated England in the final by 71 runs at Hagley Oval in Christchurch, New Zealand.
 
• Alyssa Healy became the first batter in the history of the game to hit a hundred in the semi-final and the final of the World Cup.
 
• New Zealand: 
 
 
• Capital - Wellington.
 
• Currency - New Zealand dollar.
 
• National Sport - Rugby.
